title: Datta arcade
description: Datta Arcade — a contemporary residential structure defined by clean geometry and vertical expressions of light and form.
notes: Datta Arcade stands as an elegant composition of minimalism and rhythm, marked by its vertical fins and geometric façade articulation. The interplay of pastel hues with textured grey panels softens the building’s modern form, while deep balconies and recessed frames add both function and depth. The structure reflects an architectural balance between proportion, texture, and openness—creating a calm yet sophisticated residential identity that embodies refined urban living.
